# Muffet

![demo](img/demo.gif)

Muffet is a fast website link checker which scrapes and inspects all pages in a website recursively.

## Features

- Massive speed
- High compatibility with web browsers
- Different tag support (`a`, `img`, `link`, `script`, etc)
- Multiple output formats (text, JSON, and JUnit XML)

## Installation

### Go

If you have Go installed:

```sh
go install github.com/raviqqe/muffet/v2@latest
```

### Homebrew

On macOS and Linux:

```sh
brew install muffet
```

### Docker

```sh
docker pull raviqqe/muffet
```

## Usage

### Command line

Check a website:

```sh
muffet https://example.com
```

### Docker

```sh
docker run raviqqe/muffet https://example.com
```

### GitHub Action

[My Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/ruzickap/action-my-broken-link-checker) is a third-party GitHub Action that uses Muffet to test static websites.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

    ('link', 'imagesrcset', '/t_link_imagesrcset'),

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        print(f"GET {self.path}", flush=True)
        if self.path == "/":
            parts = []
            for tag, attr, val in TAGS:
                if attr == "srcset":
                    parts.append(f'<{tag} {attr}="{val} 1x">')
                else:
                    parts.append(f'<{tag} {attr}="{val}">')
                # close tag if needed
            body = ("<html><body>" + "".join(parts) + "</body></html>").encode()
            self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type","text/html"); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
        elif self.path.startswith("/t_"):
            body=b'ok'; self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain"); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            body=b'nf'; self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
port = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 8769

	p := os.Args[0]
	if i := strings.LastIndex(p, "/"); i >= 0 {

		p = p[i+1:]

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

func stripFragment(s string) string {
	if i := strings.Index(s, "#"); i != -1 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return s
}

func isHTMLContentType(ct string) bool {
	if ct == "" {
		return false
	}
	parts := strings.Split(ct, ";")
	base := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
	return strings.EqualFold(base, "text/html")
}

func hasFragmentID(body []byte, frag string) bool {
	fragDecoded, _ := url.PathUnescape(frag)
	s := string(body)
	for _, f := range []string{frag, fragDecoded} {
		if f == "" {
			continue
		}
		esc := regexp.QuoteMeta(f)
		pat1 := `(?i)\bid\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat1, s); matched {
			return true
		}
		pat2 := `(?i)\bname\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat2, s); matched {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func parseRobots(body string) []string {
	var disallows []string
	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
	inStar := false
	for _, line := range lines {
		if idx := strings.Index(line, "#"); idx != -1 {
			line = line[:idx]
		}
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		field := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(parts[0]))
		value := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
		if field == "user-agent" {
			if value == "*" {
				inStar = true
			} else {
				inStar = (value == "*")
			}
		} else if field == "disallow" {
			if inStar {
				disallows = append(disallows, value)
			}
		}
	}
	return disallows
}

func (c *crawler) shouldInclude(urlStr string) bool {
	if len(c.includeRes) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, r := range c.includeRes {
		if r.MatchString(urlStr) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func (c *crawler) shouldExclude(urlStr string) bool {
	for _, r := range c.excludeRes {
		if r.MatchString(urlStr) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

import (

	"net/url"
	"regexp"

	"sync"
)

func stripFragment(s string) string {
	if i := strings.Index(s, "#"); i != -1 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return s
}

func isHTMLContentType(ct string) bool {
	if ct == "" {
		return false
	}
	parts := strings.Split(ct, ";")
	base := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
	return strings.EqualFold(base, "text/html")
}

func hasFragmentID(body []byte, frag string) bool {
	fragDecoded, _ := url.PathUnescape(frag)
	s := string(body)
	for _, f := range []string{frag, fragDecoded} {
		if f == "" {
			continue
		}
		esc := regexp.QuoteMeta(f)
		pat1 := `(?i)\bid\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat1, s); matched {
			return true
		}
		pat2 := `(?i)\bname\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat2, s); matched {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func parseRobots(body string) []string {
	var disallows []string
	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
	inStar := false
	for _, line := range lines {
		if idx := strings.Index(line, "#"); idx != -1 {
			line = line[:idx]
		}
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		field := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(parts[0]))
		value := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
		if field == "user-agent" {
			if value == "*" {
				inStar = true
			} else {
				inStar = (value == "*")
			}
		} else if field == "disallow" {
			if inStar {
				disallows = append(disallows, value)
			}
		}
	}
	return disallows
}

func (c *crawler) shouldInclude(urlStr string) bool {
	if len(c.includeRes) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, r := range c.includeRes {
		if r.MatchString(urlStr) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func (c *crawler) shouldExclude(urlStr string) bool {
	for _, r := range c.excludeRes {
		if r.MatchString(urlStr) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (c *crawler) isRobotsDisallowed(u *url.URL) bool {
	if !c.opts.followRobots {
		return false
	}
	p := u.Path
	if p == "" {
		p = "/"
	}
	for _, d := range c.robotsDisallow {
		if d == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, d) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type workItem struct {
	pageURL string
	body    []byte
}

func (c *crawler) tryQueue(finalURL string, body []byte, hdr http.Header, newWorks *[]workItem, mu *sync.Mutex) {
	if body == nil {
		return
	}
	ct := hdr.Get("Content-Type")
	if !isHTMLContentType(ct) {
		return
	}
	if c.shouldExclude(finalURL) {
		return
	}
	if !c.shouldInclude(finalURL) {
		return
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(finalURL)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	if c.isRobotsDisallowed(u) {
		return
	}
	stripped := stripFragment(finalURL)
	c.visitedMu.Lock()
	if c.visited[stripped] {
		c.visitedMu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	c.visited[stripped] = true
	c.visitedMu.Unlock()
	mu.Lock()
	*newWorks = append(*newWorks, workItem{pageURL: finalURL, body: body})
	mu.Unlock()
}

package main

func stripFragment(s string) string {
	if i := strings.Index(s, "#"); i != -1 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return s
}

func isHTMLContentType(ct string) bool {
	if ct == "" {
		return false
	}
	parts := strings.Split(ct, ";")
	base := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
	return strings.EqualFold(base, "text/html")
}

func hasFragmentID(body []byte, frag string) bool {
	fragDecoded, _ := url.PathUnescape(frag)
	s := string(body)
	for _, f := range []string{frag, fragDecoded} {
		if f == "" {
			continue
		}
		esc := regexp.QuoteMeta(f)
		pat1 := `(?i)\bid\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat1, s); matched {
			return true
		}
		pat2 := `(?i)\bname\s*=\s*["']?` + esc + `(?:["'\s>]|$)`
		if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(pat2, s); matched {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func parseRobots(body string) []string {
	var disallows []string
	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
	inStar := false
	for _, line := range lines {
		if idx := strings.Index(line, "#"); idx != -1 {
			line = line[:idx]
		}
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		field := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(parts[0]))
		value := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
		if field == "user-agent" {
			if value == "*" {
				inStar = true
			} else {
				inStar = (value == "*")
			}
		} else if field == "disallow" {
			if inStar {
				disallows = append(disallows, value)
			}
		}
	}
	return disallows
}

import subprocess, http.server, threading, time, socket
def start(ct):
    s=socket.socket(); s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); port=s.getsockname()[1]; s.close()
    class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self,*a): pass
        def do_GET(self):
            if self.path=="/" :
                body=b'<html><body>hi</body></html>'
                self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type",ct); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
            else:
                b=b'nf'; self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)
    httpd=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",port),H)
    t=threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever,daemon=True); t.start()
    time.sleep(0.1)
    return httpd,t,port
def run(bin,*args):
    r=subprocess.run([bin]+list(args), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr
for ct in ['text/plain','text/html']:
    httpd,t,port = start(ct)
    base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/'
    for bin in ['/tmp/testbin','./executable']:
        rc,out,err = run(bin,base)
        print(f"ct={ct} {bin} err={err.strip()!r}")
    httpd.shutdown(); httpd.server_close(); t.join(timeout=1)

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

func (c *crawler) crawl(rootStr string) ([]pageResult, string) {
	if err := c.setupClient(); err != nil {
		return nil, err.Error()
	}
	rootURL, err := url.Parse(rootStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err.Error()
	}
	schemeLower := strings.ToLower(rootURL.Scheme)
	if rootURL.Scheme == "" {
		return nil, "missing port in address"
	}
	if schemeLower != "http" && schemeLower != "https" {
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("unsupported protocol %q. http and https are supported", rootURL.Scheme)
	}
	if rootURL.Host == "" {
		return nil, "missing port in address"
	}
	if rootURL.Hostname() == "" && rootURL.Host != "" {
		defPort := "80"
		if schemeLower == "https" {
			defPort = "443"
		}
		dialAddr := rootURL.Host + ":" + defPort
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("address %s: too many colons in address", dialAddr)
	}
	rootFetchURL := *rootURL
	rootFetchURL.Fragment = ""
	canonicalRootStripped := rootFetchURL.String()
	status, header, body, finalURL, errStr, _ := c.fetchWithRetriesFull(rootFetchURL.String(), "")
	if errStr != "" {
		return nil, errStr
	}
	_ = status
	ct := header.Get("Content-Type")
	if !isHTMLContentType(ct) {
		return nil, "root page has invalid content type"
	}
	if c.opts.followRobots {
		robotsURL := &url.URL{Scheme: rootURL.Scheme, Host: rootURL.Host, Path: "/robots.txt"}
		_, hdr2, b2, _, e2, _ := c.fetchWithRetriesFull(robotsURL.String(), "")
		if e2 != "" {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("failed to fetch robots.txt: %s", e2)
		}
		_ = hdr2
		c.robotsDisallow = parseRobots(string(b2))
	}
	if c.opts.followSitemap {
		sitemapURL := &url.URL{Scheme: rootURL.Scheme, Host: rootURL.Host, Path: "/sitemap.xml"}
		_, _, _, _, e2, _ := c.fetchWithRetriesFull(sitemapURL.String(), "")
